title: Minimum site area of a rear battleaxe site (Table 2B)
text: C4.1.1 Development which complies with the dwelling type and site area provisions set out in Table 2B and the following provisions. Table 2B Site area requirements, Minimum lot area/rear battleaxe (m2): R2 -; R2.5 -; R5 -; R10 925; R12.5 762.5; R15 655; R17.5 587.5; R20 450; R25 425; R30 410; R35 395; R40 380; R50 160; R60 120; R80 100; R100-SL -. Notes: R80 site area provisions apply to all single houses located on lots coded R100, R160 and LR, MR and HR. - Indicated not applicable. Min. Minimum site area. Av. Average site area. Site area variations are subject to C4.1.1. C4.1.4 The following variations to the minimum and average site area set out in Table 2B may be made: i. in the case of a single house; the area of a lot, survey-strata lot or strata lot approved by the WAPC; or ii. the area of any existing lot, survey-strata lot or strata lot with permanent legal access to a public road, notwithstanding that it is less than that required in Table 2B.

exceptions.label: C4.1.4(i) area of a lot, survey-strata lot or strata lot approved by the WAPC
C4.1.4(ii) existing lot with permanent legal access to a public road

verified.note: Battleaxe values checked. C4.1.5 to C4.1.7 reduce 'the minimum and average site area of Table 2B'; whether that reaches the 'Minimum lot area/rear battleaxe' column is not stated on the page.

notes: Applies to a battleaxe site (rule condition). Area calculated per C4.1.3(ii)-(iv): R40 and below includes the access leg where the leg is no more than 20% of the required area, plus half an adjoining ROW/reserve up to 2 m; R50 and above excludes the leg and truncations (effective lot area). R2-R5 and R100-SL: no battleaxe figure (null). Whether the C4.1.5-C4.1.7 concessions reduce the battleaxe column is not stated ('minimum and average site area'); not applied here.
